load_libnat_library: load the libnat CUDA or CPU library for Levenshtein distance computation in fairseq NAT models
get_ins_targets: generate insertion target labels and masked tokens from input and output token sequences using Levenshtein distance
get_del_targets: compute deletion target labels for non-autoregressive translation by comparing input and output token sequences
apply_ins_masks: apply insertion masks to reorder and expand input tokens and scores into output sequences
fill_tensor_with_mask: fill tensor x with values from y at masked positions along dimension 0 with padding support
